Each public new-destination boundary requires real admitted work and callback identity, checkpoints without debit, and refuses missing/detached context before any default-work fallback. In-request compilation, recording, encoding and readback use the same work object.

Only the budget profile multiplies source position/rotation error widths by exact 2 and five derivative bounds by exact 1+2^-48. Exact zeros remain zero. Paid arithmetic and checkpoints feed unchanged outward primitive, chord, arc and total calculations. The independent reader still proves all minimum bounds and complete inequalities at the requested tolerance; a finite reserve is not treated as universal deliverability.

Only the budget profile sets the lever uncertainty to exact zero when all three authored lever components are exact numeric zero. Existing rotation/guard work is retained. R*0 and its cross product produce zero angular impulse; the prior angular velocity enclosure is still added. Nonzero levers and prior profiles use the original formula. Tests cover an earlier off-center impulse followed by center/noncenter impulses.

The original 124 of 126 independent conformance functions are AST-identical, including complete inequality and source minimum checks. Only target metadata and dispatch changed in that module. All original resource constant/default definitions pass the preservation audit. Earlier profile branches do not receive the new reserve or exact-center correction. Static preservation did not prove global compatibility: a23's completed full run failed on construction storage and discovery shape. Those defects are repaired in the new candidate, and its full compatibility run remains pending.
